property_summary: For any caller and positive amount, the reference C reverts when receiver == address(0) (so the call does not succeed), whereas the mutant that removes the zero-address guard may succeed (or at least not revert) for some inputs — the test asserts the reference always reverts for receiver==address(0) and the mutant will allow a successful call for some fuzzed amount/actor.
change_summary: Changed the zero-address guard to allow zero-address, which can change observable behavior by attempting to send to address(0).
